decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight still has its own page, fits the modular track system, and costs little to keep within a broad range, so keeping the option open remains sensible while its value becomes clearer.
Launched only in 2024 and close to the core offer, the flexible LED spotlight's prospects are still uncertain and keeping it costs little, so it stays on the market.
The multi-outlet ceiling canopy is a low-cost system component that supports the sales of many pendant luminaires, so keeping it preserves value across the range.
The low-voltage canopy adds flexibility to the firm's modular systems at little holding cost, and one year of results is too early to judge it.
The round glass track luminaires are only mentioned rather than featured, which is a weaker signal, but they are new, close to the core offer, and cheap to keep, so the option stays open for now.
